svg.title: ShopOS
svg.desc: ShopOS, multi-tenant operations software for wholesale and retail shops. Problem: keep the answer to what a product costs and how much is in stock at each branch true and traceable. Mechanism: controller, service layer, model with a tenant guard, MongoDB; stock transfers run as one transaction. Decision: the model layer throws on any query without an organizationId. Limit: aggregation pipelines bypass the guard and transactions need a MongoDB replica set. Solo project, 51 commits, no hosted demo.
